description: A covered front porch viewed from a three-quarter angle from the front walk, looking back toward a pair of dark-stained french doors with multi-pane glazing. The porch floor is painted light grey, and three painted wood steps with a clean white railing descend to a brick walkway below. At the far end of the porch, a pair of natural wood Adirondack chairs sit side by side near the french doors, one holding a blue plaid throw pillow. A small round plant stand holds a white terra cotta pot near the chairs. The surrounding landscape includes established pines and mixed low shrubs along the foundation, with a neighborhood streetscape visible behind the trees. The doors are a warm dark mahogany stain with brass hardware visible on the multi-pane frame. Soft afternoon natural light floods the covered porch space, giving the white painted wood surfaces a clean, inviting warmth. The palette is predominantly white and warm grey with the dark door providing a strong focal anchor. Camera is at standing eye-level outside the porch, with a normal lens, in a three-quarter view showing the entry porch corridor and the door at the far end.
